groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Good morning, everyone. This is a notice for tenants in the Harbor Point offices. The west elevator will be out of service from nine until noon today while technicians replace a door sensor. During that time, please use the east elevator or the stairs beside the reception desk. Deliveries larger than a handcart should wait until after noon because the east elevator is narrower. The building cafe and lobby will remain open as usual. We appreciate your patience while this safety work is completed.

questions.question_text: Why is the west elevator unavailable?

options.text: A door sensor is being replaced.
A delivery is blocking the entrance.

questions.question_text: What are tenants asked to use before noon?

options.text: The east elevator or the stairs.

questions.question_text: What is said about large deliveries?

options.text: They must be brought through the cafe.
They will receive priority elevator access.
They should be delayed until after noon.
They have been canceled for the day.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Hello, Ms. Tran. This is Leo from Northside Furnishings calling about your desk delivery tomorrow. Our truck can still arrive in the morning, but the driver has been assigned a wider delivery window, from ten to noon, because of roadwork on Pine Street. You do not need to stay home the whole time. If you leave the front-desk staff a signed delivery note, they can accept the package for you. Please call us by six this evening only if you want to choose a different day.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the voicemail?

options.text: To update a delivery time window.
To request payment for a repair.

questions.question_text: Why has the delivery window changed?

options.text: The desk is still being assembled.
There is roadwork on Pine Street.
The driver is attending a meeting.

questions.question_text: What should Ms. Tran do if she wants another delivery day?

options.text: Call the company by six this evening.
Leave a note with the cafe staff.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Here is the eight o'clock traffic update. Eastbound traffic on Route 14 is moving slowly near Mill Bridge after a minor collision, but both lanes remain open. Drivers heading downtown can save about ten minutes by using Lake Avenue instead. The south parking lot at Central Station is already full, while the north lot still has roughly forty spaces. Rail service is operating on schedule, so commuters who have not left home may want to consider the train this morning.

questions.question_text: What happened near Mill Bridge?

options.text: A lane was closed for construction.

questions.question_text: What route is recommended for drivers going downtown?
What does the speaker suggest some commuters do?

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Welcome to the Ridgeway History Museum. Before entering the main galleries, please place large bags in the free lockers to your left. Small handbags may be carried inside. Photography is permitted in most rooms, but flash photography is not allowed because it can damage light-sensitive objects. At eleven thirty, our guide will begin a twenty-minute tour of the new map exhibit from the central staircase. If you would like to join, pick up a blue tour card at the information desk now because space is limited.

questions.question_text: What should visitors do with large bags?

options.text: Put them in the free lockers.
Carry them only in the map exhibit.
Give them to the tour guide.

questions.question_text: Why is flash photography prohibited?

options.text: It slows entry to the galleries.

questions.question_text: What should a visitor do to join the tour?

options.text: Reserve online after the tour begins.
Meet at the locker area at noon.
Pay an extra fee at the staircase.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Attention, shoppers. Our weekend reading sale begins today and runs through Sunday evening. All travel guides are twenty percent off, and members receive an additional five percent discount on those titles. The author talk scheduled for three o'clock has moved from the cafe to the second-floor event room, where there is more seating. Customers who purchased tickets do not need new ones. After the talk, signed copies of the author's latest book will be available at the event-room entrance while supplies last.

questions.question_text: What items are discounted this weekend?
Why was the author talk moved?

options.text: To be closer to the store entrance.
To avoid interrupting a music class.
To make room for a delivery.

questions.question_text: What is available after the talk?

options.text: Signed copies of the latest book.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Hello, Mr. Patel. This is Greenway Clinic calling about your appointment with Dr. Ellis on Thursday. The doctor will be in a training session during the first part of the morning, so we need to move your visit from nine fifteen to ten thirty. Your laboratory work is already complete, and no additional tests are required before you arrive. If ten thirty is inconvenient, please call the scheduling desk before four o'clock tomorrow. Otherwise, we will keep the new time for you automatically.

questions.question_text: Why is the clinic changing the appointment time?

options.text: The doctor has a training session.
The clinic is opening late for repairs.
The patient requested a different doctor.

questions.question_text: What does the speaker say about laboratory work?

options.text: It can only be done after ten thirty.
It has been sent to another clinic.

questions.question_text: What will happen if Mr. Patel does not call?

options.text: The new appointment time will be kept.
The doctor will call him personally.
The visit will return to nine fifteen.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: This is a quick facilities update for the third floor. The large printer beside Conference Room C has been producing faded pages for several days, and yesterday's service visit confirmed that its imaging unit needs replacement. The part will not arrive until Friday, so the printer will remain offline until then. For high-volume jobs, please use the copy center on the first floor. The smaller printer near the kitchen is working, but staff should avoid sending more than fifty pages at once so it does not become overloaded.

questions.question_text: What problem was confirmed during the service visit?

options.text: The printer needs a new imaging unit.
The paper trays are too small.

questions.question_text: When is the replacement part expected?
What are staff asked to do with large print jobs?

options.text: Split every job into ten-page sections.
Send the files to Conference Room C.
Wait until the smaller printer is moved.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Passengers using the Riverside Airport shuttle, please note a temporary stop change. Because the curb outside Terminal B is being resurfaced, all hotel shuttles will depart from Zone 4 outside Terminal A until six o'clock this evening. Signs have been placed along the covered walkway between the terminals, and the walk takes about five minutes. The shuttle schedule itself has not changed. Buses will continue to leave every thirty minutes, with the next departure at two fifteen. Please allow extra walking time if you are checking out of a hotel this afternoon.

questions.question_text: Why has the shuttle stop been moved?

options.text: Terminal A is closed for cleaning.
The curb at Terminal B is being resurfaced.
A flight delay blocked the road.

questions.question_text: What does the speaker say has not changed?
What can passengers infer about reaching Zone 4?

options.text: They need to take a train between terminals.
They must ask a hotel employee for access.
They can only reach it after six o'clock.
They should allow about five extra minutes to walk.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: Before tonight's dinner service, I want to review the new procedure for online pickup orders. When an order is ready, place it on the numbered shelf that matches the final two digits of the customer's order code. Do not put drinks on the shelf. Keep them in the refrigerator beside the counter and hand them over when the customer arrives. If a customer is more than thirty minutes late, move hot food to the warming cabinet and update the order status on the tablet. This system should reduce mix-ups during our busiest hour.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the instruction?

options.text: To introduce a new dinner menu.
To assign employees to cleaning duties.
To explain a new pickup-order procedure.
To describe a customer reward program.

questions.question_text: Where should drinks be kept before customers arrive?

options.text: In the refrigerator beside the counter.

questions.question_text: What should staff do when a customer is over thirty minutes late?

options.text: Cancel the order and refund it immediately.
Put all items back in regular storage.
Call the customer from the manager's office.
Move hot food to the warming cabinet and update the status.

groups.instructions: Listen to the following talk and answer the three questions.
groups.transcript: N: I have an update on Saturday's neighborhood clean-up. We expected about forty volunteers, but sixty-two people have now registered, so we are dividing the group into three teams instead of two. Team leaders will meet at the community center at eight fifteen to collect gloves, maps, and trash bags. Everyone else should arrive by eight forty-five. The forecast calls for light rain in the afternoon, so we plan to finish outdoor work by noon and hold the thank-you lunch indoors. Volunteers who can bring a reusable water bottle are encouraged to do so.

questions.question_text: Why will there be three volunteer teams?
Who should arrive at eight fifteen?
Why is the outdoor work planned to end by noon?

options.text: The community center closes at noon.
Lunch has been moved to another neighborhood.
The cleanup permit expires in the morning.
Rain is expected later in the day.
